title: Smart Paddy Irrigation System Using IoT in Anuradhapura
author: Dr. Nimal Perera & Team
summary: An automated soil-moisture sensor network designed to reduce water wastage by 35% in Sri Lanka's North Central Province.
details: This study deployed low-cost LoRaWAN soil moisture and weather sensors across 15 paddy fields in Anuradhapura. Real-time data was transmitted to farmers via a mobile dashboard, optimizing irrigation schedules and increasing crop yield while conserving reservoir water.

title: Mangrove Restoration & Coastal Carbon Sequestration in Negombo
author: Prof. Chamari Silva
summary: Evaluating blue carbon storage capacity and biodiversity recovery in rehabilitated mangrove ecosystems.
details: Over a 24-month period, researchers measured biomass growth and sediment carbon levels in replanted mangrove zones around the Negombo Lagoon. Findings highlight a 42% increase in juvenile fish habitats and significant coastal erosion protection.

title: Digital Payment Adoption Among Rural SMEs in Sri Lanka
author: W.M.S.S. Weerakoon & Research Group
summary: Investigating barriers and catalysts for QR-based fintech adoption among small-scale retail merchants.
details: Based on survey data from 300 rural entrepreneurs, this research analyzes trust factors, transaction fee sensitivity, and digital literacy impacts on LankaQR adoption, offering policy recommendations for regional banking institutions.

title: AI-Powered Early Detection of Tea Leaf Blister Blight
author: K.D. Jayasinghe
summary: A lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) mobile tool for upcountry tea estate workers.
details: Trained on 8,500 high-resolution leaf images from Nuwara Eliya estates, this offline-capable mobile application identifies early fungal infection with 94.2% accuracy, enabling targeted fungicide application.

title: Sustainable Eco-Tourism Supply Chains in Ella & Haputale
author: S.M. Rathnayake
summary: Assessing community-based tourism models and local economic retention in Sri Lanka's hill country.
details: This study maps the value chain of boutique eco-lodges and homestays, demonstrating how direct sourcing from local organic farmers increases community income retention by 28%.

title: Solar Microgrid Feasibility for Off-Grid Island Communities
author: Eng. R. Bandara
summary: Technical and financial modeling of hybrid solar-battery microgrids for Northern Province islands.
details: Using HOMER Pro simulations and load profiling, this research outlines a scalable 150kW solar microgrid blueprint capable of delivering 24/7 clean electricity while reducing diesel generator dependency by 80%.
